messages:
Maya: Heads up 1: enterprise compliance asks converging into a single initiative: long-term audit retention, BYOK enrollment flows, and SOC2 evidence export. Need to pick a prioritized MVP and acceptance criteria this week.

Diego: What's the smallest ship that still satisfies sales? They want evidence export + quick BYOK for two pilots. Retention can be phased.

Aisha: Sales asked for a timeline. My read: BYOK handshake + attestation docs are non-negotiable for bank pilots. Evidence export is lower-risk feature-wise. Retention is highest infra impact.

Maya: Proposal: Phase 1 (Q3): BYOK pilot (handshake, minimal escrow, attestation checklist) + SOC2 evidence export beta. Phase 2 (Q4): Tiered retention opt-in (90d hot + 18mo cold) + restore runbook. Phase 3 (H1 next year): Optional full-warm longer retention on contract. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Diego: Support that ordering. Add acceptance criteria for BYOK pilot: signed LOA, documented key policy, and at least one successful attest/rotate flow.

Aisha: For evidence export beta: need export format spec (PDF + JSON manifest) and a checklist for legal hold. Also include query scoping so export size is bounded.

Maya: Good call. Draft acceptance criteria so we can sign off: 
- BYOK pilot: handshake + escrow process documented, KMS attestation report, onboarding checklist, 2 customers onboarded
- Evidence export: self-serve export + support runbook, manifest includes hashes, export size cap 100GB per job
- Retention tiered: opt-in toggle, restore <6h for beta, telemetry + cost alerts

Finance: Quick note: need provisional pricing for extended retention and export labor. If restore jobs are frequent, ops cost could be material.

InfraBot: FYI: I created infra ticket infra/retention-tiering and assigned to Diego (#789). Baseline ETA 6w for prototype.

Diego: Engineering estimate tweak: BYOK pilot plumbing + attestation flow ~2 sprints (manual onboarding for initial customers). Evidence export work ~1 sprint. Tiered retention prototype ~3 sprints. Can parallelize BYOK + export.

Maya: Risk log: 
- Legal/contract churn for BYOK escrow (Legal to standardize clause)
- Cost overruns if restores > expected
- Search latency regressions if we keep 24mo warm

LegalBot: Working on BYOK clause template and an attestation checklist. Will ping Aisha for export manifest language. ETA 10 business days for drafts.

Aisha: For export manifest, propose fields: tenant_id, export_id, query_range, record_count, compressed_size, sha256_manifest, tarball_sha256, created_by, legal_hold_flag. Quick mock in thread on format.

Maya: Decision request: Approve ordering Phase1(BYOK+Export) then Phase2(retention-tiered)? Please react.

Diego: +1

Aisha: +1

Finance: +1 assuming pricing follow-up next week

Maya: Approved. Action items: 
- @LegalBot: drop BYOK clause + attestation checklist in 10bd
- @Diego: spike BYOK onboarding + export prototype (start this sprint)
- @Aisha: draft export manifest and UX copy for legal hold
- @Finance: model restore/op cost scenarios with 3 usage buckets
- @Maya: schedule customer selection sync Fri 2pm

Maya: Any objections?

Diego: One ask: add telemetry events: `retention.opt_in`, `export.job_started`, `export.job_completed`, `byok.handshake_completed`. We need those to track beta health.

Maya: Noted, adding to action list.

InfraBot: Runbook placeholder created: runbooks/retention-restore (draft).

Maya: Great work team. I'll surface this to GTM and assign follow-ups in Asana.
